display_name: Phase1 既有恢复网络的 Tri-SIG-TIME 同基座对照
description: 将已有 Phase1 DURA 恢复 IQ 经冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 重新识别，与新候选的同输入原始预测按同物理 ID 对照。

data.representation: Existing Phase1 fixed DURA restored IQ plus fixed raw Tri-SIG-TIME decisions; exact identical ordered physical IDs
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: No training or label access before all predictions

permissions.regime: Frozen Phase1 DURA outputs and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only
permissions.query_use: Per-record frozen prediction, no adaptation or training
permissions.claim_scope: Matched single-seed Phase1 seven-view DURA baseline

checkpoint.initialization: Existing Phase1 DURA restored IQ, no G checkpoint loaded; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50/11100
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA complete IQ manifest and exact ordered 168000 Phase1 physical IDs; original Tri-SIG-TIME source checkpoint ancestry
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original fixed Phase1 IQ reconstruction, reader loaded directly from original Phase1 release

metric_names: Tri-SIG-TIME raw clean, per-scene raw and restored accuracy, macro F1 and clean-relative gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: Each of six restored practical scenes within 3 percentage points of same reader raw clean; restored clean degradation at most 1 percentage point

notes: 重用已有 Phase1 DURA 七视图恢复 IQ，不使用旧识别器 logits、features 或旧分数；Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 重新产生分类决策，训练更新为零。
正式参考、原始预测和 DURA IQ 的完整 168000 条物理 ID 必须严格同序；固定 clean 与六场景全部预测完成后才允许 CPU scorer 连接 truth。
原始预测采用当前候选完整冻结的同一 Tri-SIG-TIME 原始输入预测；等待前序控制器及 GPU worker 均退出，不以其测试分数决定运行。
本对照仅作为有真实样本对应的基准，不对测试数据执行任何拟合、模型选择或参数更新。
